scripts.build: pnpm skills:check && pnpm lint && tsc -b packages/ids packages/db packages/lint apps/api apps/grader apps/cli
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && pnpm --filter @egma/web typecheck
scripts.clean: tsc -b --clean packages/ids packages/db packages/lint apps/api apps/grader apps/cli
scripts.test: { pnpm test:fast; fast=$?; pnpm test:browser; browser=$?; pnpm test:simulator; sim=$?; pnpm test:sdk; sdk=$?; pnpm test:fixture; fix=$?; exit $(( fast || browser || sim || sdk || fix )); }
scripts.test:fast: pnpm db:up && echo "\nlane: fast — every test except the real-browser proof\n" && vitest run --project fast
scripts.test:browser: pnpm db:up && echo "\nlane: browser — the real-browser proof, and nothing else\n" && vitest run --project browser
